title: carex perakensis var. borneensis
intro: Carex perakensis var. borneensis, commonly known as the Bornean sedge, is a plant species belonging to the family Cyperaceae. It has been traditionally used in folk medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to aid in the treatment of fever, inflammation, and respiratory issues due to its anti-inflammatory and expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Carex perakensis var. borneensis include its role as an anti-inflammatory agent, which may help in reducing swelling and pain, as well as its antimicrobial properties, which can aid in the prevention of infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
